title: Movies & TV Filming Locations Private Group Walking Tour
blurb:
Step back into the Pop-Culture past and walk along iconic streets and dirty back alleys of Miami Beach as we explore the vibrant and historic locations that brought the big screen to life.

Miami Vice caused the "Vice Effect" which placed the forgotten city on a global map. I have made it my mission to bring these stories to life through passion, extensive research, storytelling, and visual aids. Guided tour includes a portable screen to watch scenes from the show right where they were filmed, allowing us to visually travel back in time.

You'll gain insider knowledge on movie & TV creation, experience the buildings, street corners, and interior spaces which were used as filming locations, and discover fascinating nuggets about the checkered history of the 1980s Miami. Every stop is a scene, every building a backdrop, every lobby a close-up, and every detail a story waiting to be told.
